name: Crown Guard Tower
summary: In the southern Eastern Plaguelands, blight surrounds Crown Guard Tower's ruins. The Scourge destroyed it during the invasion of Lordaeron in the Third War.

sections.title: A Fallen Bulwark
sections.body: Crown Guard Tower once watched over eastern Lordaeron as part of the Kingdom's defenses. When the Scourge overran the kingdom, they destroyed the tower and left it in ruins. Several fallen towers lie scattered across what are now the Eastern Plaguelands. Charred stones remain here in a land still held by the undead.

faq.q: What was Crown Guard Tower originally built for?
faq.answer: Crown Guard Tower was built as a regional military watchtower and scout outpost for the human Kingdom of Lordaeron before the Third War. It guarded the roads against incursions.
The Scourge destroyed Crown Guard Tower during their invasion of Lordaeron. Waves of undead overran the kingdom's defenses and left the structure in rubble.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Crown Guard Tower's ruins recall how completely the Scourge broke the Kingdom of Lordaeron's defenses.
